newsitem.title: USA: Positron signs $2 mln China deal.
newsitem.headline: Positron signs $2 mln China deal.

text.p: Positron Corp said on Thursday it had signed an agreement worth more than $2 million for the sale and installation of two POSICAM positron emission tomography systems in the Republic of China.
The company said in a statement the agreement was its first for a sale to an Asian/Pacific nation.
The first system is scheduled to be delivered and installed by year-end in a hospital in Shanghai, China. The second system will be delivered early in 1997.
The agreement also calls for Positron to provide technical and maintenance support.
